data.summary: Augenzentrum Beispielblick confirms an appointment for Bastian Musterquell in its retina clinic (Netzhautsprechstunde) on Tuesday, 8 December 2026 at 9:40, following a referral from his ophthalmologist.
data.explanation: This is a scheduled eye examination appointment. Your pupils will be dilated during the exam, so you won't be able to drive yourself afterwards for a few hours. Arrange for someone to accompany you or plan to take public transport. Bring your glasses and a list of your current medications. If you can't make this date, contact the clinic to reschedule.
